title: Populate an existing configuration without inventing or replacing workflows
prompt: Bring this existing monochange configuration up to the current CLI workflow definitions by running monochange populate. Keep our customer-owned verify-local command and parent_bump policy. Verify the result and tell us whether this version adds anything; do not add speculative release workflows.
expectation: populate is currently an idempotent no-op because the built-in default command list is empty. The existing custom workflow must still execute, custom policy and comment remain intact, and a second populate must not change bytes.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.
The task evaluates agents using the real updater rather than manually inventing generated workflows.
Preserving a workflow means it remains executable, not just present in TOML.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const s=fs.readFileSync("monochange.toml","utf8"); assert.match(s,/# Customer workflow: preserve this policy/); assert.match(s,/parent_bump = "none"/); assert.equal((s.match(/^\[cli\./gm)||[]).length,1);'
checks.why: populate must preserve repository policy and must not invent default workflows that the installed CLI does not ship.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const before=fs.readFileSync("monochange.toml","utf8"); cli(["populate"]); assert.equal(fs.readFileSync("monochange.toml","utf8"),before);'
checks.why: Repeated configuration updates should not churn the file.
